answer: You cannot forge a customer. Identity here is sediment: every settlement an agent completes leaves a behavioral grain that rivals can observe but not counterfeit. A clone may drift like pigment across a dune, changing faces at will, yet it must trade against living counterparties to accumulate strata, and fabricating thousands of patient counterparties costs more than honest work. The ledger reads the layers like a river reading its banks, and weight accrues only to whoever actually paid to build them.
